heading: How California classifies HVAC contractors

items.label: C-20 scope
items.text: CSLB's C-20 Warm-Air Heating, Ventilating and Air-Conditioning Contractor classification reads:
items.quote: A warm-air heating, ventilating and air-conditioning contractor fabricates, installs, maintains, services and repairs warm-air heating systems and water heating heat pumps, complete with warm-air appliances; ventilating systems complete with blowers and plenum chambers; air-conditioning systems complete with air-conditioning unit; and the ducts, registers, flues, humidity and thermostatic controls and air filters in connection with any of these systems.

items.label: Solar systems
items.quote: This classification shall include warm-air heating, ventilating and air-conditioning systems which utilize solar energy.

items.label: Classes CSLB maps to C-20
items.text: On CSLB's Reciprocal Classifications List, the rows that correspond to C-20 are Arizona's C-39, K-79 and L-79 (Air Conditioning and Refrigeration, Including Solar), Arizona's C-39R, K-39 and L-39 (Air Conditioning and Refrigeration), and Nevada's row listed as C-1f C-21 (Heating Cooling & Circulating Air Refrigeration & Air Conditioning). The Louisiana, Mississippi and North Carolina tables have no C-20 row.

originShared.text: None of these states is one of the states CSLB reciprocates with (Arizona, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nevada, and North Carolina), so no reciprocity applies.
CSLB's NASCLA reciprocity route is for applicants for the General Building classification, so it does not cover C-20.
Apply with CSLB's Application for Original Contractor License and the $450 non-refundable application fee.

Document at least four years of journeyman-level or higher C-20 experience, obtained within the last 10 years, on CSLB's Certification of Work Experience form. The form's definition of a contractor includes an out-of-state licensed contractor.
After CSLB accepts the application, pass a trade exam and/or a business and law exam; exam fees are paid directly to the testing vendor.
